title: 🚀 Cursor Estonia Hackathon
content:
🚀 Cursor Estonia Hackathon

Today I joined the Cursor Estonia Hackathon — a fun and fast-paced afternoon hackathon right here in Tallinn! 🎉

I showcased my Tetris AI project, and it was awesome to share it with fellow makers and see their reactions. 🤖🧩



And of course... the food deserves a special mention. The truffle pizza was absolutely delicious! 🍕✨
